S/U only.

Social impact of evolution discussed from a biological perspective. Can be repeated for a maximum of 12 credits.
Not for graduate credit.
S/U Only.
ENT385 (BIO385) | Introductory Entomology, effective Fall 2026 Change prerequisites (3 crs.) Cross-listed as (ENT), BIO385.
Introduction to the diverse components of entomology, emphasizing basic principles of insect morphology, physiology, behavior, and ecology.
Current topics in insect biodiversity and management strategies. (Lec. 3) Pre: BIO262 or PLS200 or permission of instructor.
